fees.text: £10,050 per year for UK students joining in 2027/28 (the maximum the UK Government allows). City says fees for later years may also increase in line with government policy.

source.evidence: Saturday, 21st November 2026, 10:00 – 16:00

contextual.summary: Home-fee applicants to the first year of an undergraduate degree who meet one or more of City's contextual criteria can get a reduced offer, usually made automatically from your UCAS form.
contextual.typicalReduction: Up to two grades (or up to 16 tariff points) below the standard entry requirements: one A-level grade lower with one criterion, no more than two grades with more than one criterion, and the full reduction if you have been in local authority care.

criteria.detail: Have spent three months or more in local authority care (taken from your UCAS form, so declare it).
Your postcode is in an area with low progression to higher education as measured by POLAR4: Quintile 1 or 2.

You attend a lower-performing school or college: in the lowest 20% for average QCA points per A-level student (or equivalent) in England, Wales or Northern Ireland, as identified by the Department for Education and provided via UCAS. City publishes a list of eligible schools.
You are the first generation of your family to go to university (information provided by UCAS).
Estranged student: aged 25 or below and studying without the support and approval of either parent because the relationship has broken down.
Have caring responsibilities: you give unpaid care to a family member, partner or friend who could not cope without your support.

Have received free school meals. City's wording: if you received free school meals up until the end of your final year, your UCAS application fee can be waived and the University may factor this in when making your offer (page refers to the 2025 cycle).

contextual.rulesText: You must be a Home-fee paying student applying for the first year of an undergraduate degree through UCAS (foundation courses are not included) and meet one or more of the criteria. Contextual offers apply to A level, BTEC, CTEC, LIBF/IFS, WJEC Diploma and International Baccalaureate qualifications. City says some programmes have grade requirements that cannot be lowered (for example B in A level Mathematics).

source.evidence: You must also meet one or more of the following criteria:
